A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have identified a set of features that are highly likely to indicate PCD.
PCD can present with atypical features, such as cough, and that the likelihood of PCD in children with atypical features is higher than previously reported.
the prevalence of PCD is higher in the pediatric population than previously recognized, with the highest prevalence in the youngest age group.

the clinical phenotype is not specific to PCID and is similar in patients with and without PCID.
primary ciliary dyskinesia is underdiagnosed in children.
